svg.title: SafePay: how a payment flows
svg.text: The LLMs sit outside the authority path. Every number comes from deterministic code; PostgreSQL refuses anything that breaks the books.
email or text PDF, untrusted data
no tools, strict JSON schema out
hard rules, caps under a row lock
T4 freeze: outflow stops, tokens revoked
Tiers: T1 auto, T2 cool-off with owner veto, T3 human, T4 freeze. All data is SYNTHETIC and the bank is SIMULATED.
